info.name: Travlla Tour Manager API
info.description:
REST API for the Travlla tour booking script: tours, availability, pricing, bookings, customer accounts and vendor endpoints.

Setup: set the baseUrl variable to your site URL. Run "Login" (or "Register") once; the returned token is saved to the token variable automatically. If you set an API key in Admin > Settings > API, put it in the apiKey variable and enable the X-API-KEY header.

{"data":{"id":1,"name":"Paris City of Light Break","description":"Iconic monuments, world-class art and timeless Parisian romance.","content":"
